reason: A web UI monitoring widget that polls OpenCode Zen usage data and displays rolling, weekly, and monthly Go subscription quota percentages with refresh status and low-balance indicators.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框工具栏中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅的滚动、每周和每月剩余配额百分比。
summaries.en: Displays rolling, weekly, and monthly OpenCode Go subscription quota percentages in the DeepSeek Harness Web composer toolbar.

capabilities: Reads the configured OpenCode Go API key through the host credential service
Polls the OpenCode Zen usage endpoint for quota data
Serves quota snapshots to the web interface and renders them in the composer toolbar
